entry = await rlm.harness.create_memory(title='Continual ARC: horizontal divider and stacked shapes', content='For ARC tasks with a 15x15 input divided by a full horizontal 5 line at row 5, the top area contains three 3x3 shapes: a color-1 shape, a color-2 T-like marker, and a distinct rightmost colored shape. The region below the divider contains a copy of the color-1 shape, positioned somewhere in the 9x15 lower area. Output is 9x15: remove the top region and divider, keep the lower 9 input rows (rows 6-14) as the base, then translate the rightmost top shape (preserving its color, 3x3 pattern and orientation) to align horizontally with the lower color-1 shape. Place it immediately adjacent vertically to the lower shape: the orientation of the color-2 marker indicates whether to put it above or below; examples with the marker stem ending in a bottom bar place it above, and marker with top bar and downward stem places it below. Keep blank rows elsewhere. Demonstrations show when the lower shape starts at output row 5, the rightmost shape occupies rows 2-4; when base starts row 3, chosen object can occupy rows 0-2 or 6-8 according to the marker; when base starts row 1, object occupies rows 4-6. This rule solved task-d9964257.', global_=True)
entry
